HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.

3. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   C. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   D. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   C. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   B. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

9. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   B. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

11. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   B. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.

12. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   D. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   B. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   D. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   C. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   B. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Inclusivity and Interdependence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
